+"""The IncludeCycleError error and its helper."""
+
+class IncludeCycleError(Exception):
+    """Raised for include cycle problems."""
+
+
+def raise_include_cycle(message: str, line: int, column: int, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(message)
+    full_message = message if message.endswith(".") else message + "."
+    if line < 1:
+        raise IncludeCycleError(full_message)
+    raise IncludeCycleError(full_message)
